title: Share buffered MCP event parsing without changing caller policy
goal: Vision: V-6. Reduce complete Susi core source while preserving every capability by reusing buffered SSE JSON frame parsing between the peer MCP client and Susi Harness.

reuse.searched: susi-core/src/mcp_client.rs buffered event parser; susi-harness/src/mcp.rs response selection; susi-wire-client/src/sse.rs streaming decoder and mcp.rs classifier; existing dependency edges through susi-core and susi-paths
reuse.reason: Expose the existing core buffered JSON/SSE mechanics to the harness through its existing core dependency. Keep line normalization, response choice, errors, authentication, transport, deadlines, version negotiation and the wire streaming decoder at their current callers. No external source or dependency is needed.

validation.detail: 11 core and 24 harness tests; private target and runtime-home paths

results.policy_preservation: Core retains its original line handling, exact numeric request matching, method rejection and RPC error text. Harness retains extra-CR normalization, first matching answer, last-answer fallback, and empty/error/malformed-frame handling. No changes to versions, auth, transport, byte caps, timeouts or wire streaming callbacks.
results.integration: Pending parent integration; no commit or publication performed.

peer_review: Independent review found no behavior differences in SSE line normalization/selection, numeric diagnostics/order, probe validation/admission/error lifetime, or plane defaults. All new helpers counted.
